user_sees: The text wraps or is cut with dots; every button can still be reached
must_not: Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the Feedback message, help question saved with its text cut without a word to the user

steps.action: Type a question about the app and send it
user_sees: A short answer written from the help articles
'Did this solve it?' with Yes and No
must_not: The message lost when the AI is slow
An answer that names another gym or member

steps.action: Tap Yes
user_sees: The answer stays; the tap is kept once
must_not: A second rating saved for the same question
Text over other text, a button pushed off the screen, or the Feedback message, help question saved with its text cut without a word to the user

note: Text cut at 2000 letters refused, not trimmed; Hinglish goes to the AI as data
